channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about JJ Barea | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about JJ Barea from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Markieff Morris on John Wall, JJ Barea
item.description:
(2/2)Morris on Barea's comments on John Wall:

“He don’t even know us. Like how do you know if we like him or not? What is he talking about. (Expletive) J.J. I heard he was a good dude but you know, you come at my teammate – (expletive) him. Straight like that.”

Markieff Morris on John Wall, JJ Barea, Jan 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle:

“We’re going 2 keep all our point guards. All those guys, Williams, Barea, Harris, Felton, those guys are going 2 be on the team.”

Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea, Oct 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Mark Cuban on JJ Barea
item.description:
Mark Cuban on J.J. Barea:

“If we can just get back Jet (Jason Terry) we’ll be set. J.J. became available and they got a hold of us and said, ‘Look, we think we’re going to get waived. Would you guys have an interest in him coming back?’I talked to coach, talked to Donny, and it wasn’t an easy decision because we really like Gal. He improved dramatically and we think he’s got a real spot in this league but coach was like, ‘Look, being able to go small with J.J., with Raymond out initially, it’ll be a good compliment.’ So ‘who let the baby on the court’ is back.”

Mark Cuban on JJ Barea, Oct 30, 2014. Source: Dallas Morning News.
